name: VisitingVienna Film Festivals
notes: WordPress article, no ld+json/API; one h3 per festival with an id anchor, each followed by a 'Next dates: ...' sentence in English prose (e.g. 'October 22nd to November 3rd, 2026'). Entries with 'Next dates: TBA' (next edition not yet announced) are skipped entirely rather than guessing a date. Page is updated ~monthly and sometimes still lists a range that has already ended by the time we scrape it; those are filtered out by comparing end (or start) to today. No venue/district/price info is given per-festival on this page, so those fields are always null. Only ~14 upcoming festivals total; site publishes as far as it knows (some 2027 dates already listed), no pagination.
